meta.name: Courage
meta.description: On the bustling streets of Mumbai, Rani and Jaydeep, reunited after ten years, rekindle their bittersweet school romance. Their love faces a major challenge as Jaydeep battles a life-threatening health crisis, pushing Rani into a desperate search for a kidney transplant. Amid uncertainty and emotional turmoil, their bond deepens and inspires hope and resilience. Their courage and love prove that miracles can happen even in the face of the impossible.
